The lake's fish returned after dumping stopped.

We infer the dumping had:
A) helped the fish
B) harmed the fish
C) no effect

items.prompt:
The BEST proof for a claim is the:
A) strongest, most direct evidence
B) longest paragraph
C) first word

An inference is a conclusion based on:
A) evidence and reasoning
B) a guess
C) the title

Read.

After the plastic-bag ban, beach litter fell 60%, sea-turtle deaths dropped, and cleanup costs halved.

To show the ban helped the ENVIRONMENT, the strongest evidence is:
A) cleanup costs halved
B) litter fell 60% and turtle deaths dropped
C) the ban was passed
items.answer: B) litter fell 60% and turtle deaths dropped

steps: Direct environmental measures. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) litter fell 60% and turtle deaths dropped

items.prompt:
Why choose the STRONGEST evidence instead of any related fact?
A) it most directly supports the claim and is most convincing
B) it is always shortest

items.answer: A) it most directly supports the claim and is most convincing

solution.answer: A) it most directly supports the claim and is most convincing
